Custom Spout Pouches for Liquids: Spout Types, Sealing and Filling

Published August 24, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

For liquid spout pouches, confirm the spout and cap type, seal strength under the filling temperature, and the film barrier for the liquid. Match the spout to the cap (flip-top, screw or peel-off), verify leak resistance in shipping, and confirm food-contact documentation for your market.

Decision table

ElementTypical choiceBuyer check
SpoutFlip-top, screw or peel-sealDispensing and reseal
CapPP cap with tamper bandLeak-free seal
FilmHigh-barrier with sealant layerOil and moisture resistance
FillingHot or cold fillSeal at fill temperature
TestingLeak, drop and squeeze testsShipping durability

Match the spout to the use

A flip-top suits daily dispensing, a screw cap suits portion control, and a peel-off spout suits single-use. Confirm cap tamper evidence and whether the spout position fits your filling and packing line.

Sealing at fill temperature

Hot-fill liquids stress the seal and spout weld. Confirm the film, spout material and sealing window at your actual fill temperature, and test leak resistance after cooling.

Barrier for the liquid

Oily and acidic liquids challenge films and seals. Confirm the barrier structure and test storage stability, including cap material compatibility with the product.

Shipping reality

Pouches flex in transit. Run drop and squeeze tests with filled packs and confirm carton packing prevents spout damage.

Buyer checklist

  1. Choose spout and cap for the use
  2. Confirm seal at fill temperature
  3. Test barrier with the liquid
  4. Run leak and drop tests
  5. Confirm food-contact documents

Frequently asked questions

What spout is best for sauces?

Flip-top or screw caps suit repeated use; confirm cap reseal and leak performance with the product.

Can spout pouches be hot-filled?

Yes, but the film, spout and seal window must be matched to the fill temperature and tested.

How do I prevent spout damage in shipping?

Confirm carton packing, orientation and drop-test filled pouches before production.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Liquid spout pouches combine a stand-up body with a fitment, so the spec must cover both the film and the spout seal. The pouch body uses clear, metallized, foil-laminate or PE-based structures with the inner sealant layer matched to filling temperature; the spout area requires extra seal validation because fitment sealing is the most common leak point. MOQ is 500 PCS per size and artwork, printing is digital or gravure, and compliance review confirms exact layers, adhesives, inks and additives for the liquid type, contact time, temperature and destination market.

Frequently Asked Questions

Why do spout pouches leak at the fitment?

The spout seal is a different sealing condition from the flat seals; it must be validated separately for the specific liquid and fill temperature.

Can spout pouches be custom printed?

Yes, digital or gravure printing with matte, gloss or tactile finishes is available at MOQ 500 PCS.
